paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jordan gal a kumpipa tengteng, mual a omte, phaizang a omte, tuipi zatak dung teng a Lebanon pha a om tengteng, Hitte, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste'n ana zak un,
heading: Gibeon Mite'n Joshua Akhem Uh
english: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it

paite: Joshua leh Israelte pheikhai khat a dou tum in akikhawm uhi.
english: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

paite: Himahleh Gibeon khomite'n Joshua in Jeriko khua leh Ai khua abawldan ana zak un, lepchiahpil in agamtang uhi.
english: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,

paite: Palai a kibawl in ip lui pipi, uain thawl lui pipi, asesa kithuap nemnum sabiltungte a pua in mi akisawl uhi.
english: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wineskins,

paite: Khedap lui thuap nennon abun ua, puan lui pipi asilh ua, anek ding tanghoute uh gaw gemgom, ap khetkhut ngen ahi.
english: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

paite: Gilgal giahphual ah Joshua kiang ah ava hoh ua, akiang leh Israelte kiang ah, "Gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi ua, huaiziak in tu in kou leh nou lemna thu khung ni,” achi uhi.
english: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country. Now therefore make a covenant with us.”

paite: Israelte'n huai Hivte kiang ah, "Ka lak ua teng hi kha ni uchia; bangchi in nou toh lemna thu i khung thei dia?" achi uh.
english: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, “What if you live among us? How could we make a covenant with you?”

paite: Amau Joshua kiang ah, "Na sikhate ka hi uh," achi uhi. Joshua in akiang uah, "Kuate na hi ua? Koilam a pan hong pai na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: They said to Joshua, “We are your servants.” Joshua said to them, “Who are you? Where do you come from?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "TOUPA a Pathian min uh ka zak ziak un na sikhate gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi uh. Aminthandan, Aigupta gam a athilhih tengteng,
english: They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of Yahweh your God; for we have heard of his fame, all that he did in Egypt,

paite: Jordan lui gal a Amorte kumpipa nihte, Heshbon gam kumpipa Sihon, Bashan gam kumpipa Astaroth a om Og tung a athilhih tengteng ka na za uhi.
english: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.

paite: Ka upate uh leh ka gam ua tengte'n ka kiang uah, 'Lampi a nek ding tawi unla, amau va houpih un,' akiang uah, 'Na sikha ka hi uh. Nou toh kilem ni, na va chi ding uh," " chi in ahon sawl uhi.
english: Our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take supplies in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them. Tell them, “We are your servants. Now make a covenant with us.”’

paite: “Hiai ka nek ding uh tanghoute na kiang a hong dia ka hong pawt ni ua ka inn ua kipan asa a ka hon puak uh ahi. Himahleh tu in en dih, agaw gemgom a a-ap khetkhutta hi.
english: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and has become moldy.

paite: Hiai thawl uain ka thunnate uh leng athak ahi. En dih, avang khin vekta hi. Hiai ka puante uh leh ka khedapte uh leng ka hong paina uh agamla mahmah a, aluigawpta hi," achi uhi.
english: These wineskins, which we filled, were new; and behold, they are torn. These our garments and our sandals have become old because of the very long journey.”

paite: Mite'n atawi uh nek-le-dawn dingte achiam ua, TOUPA dong in thu akan masa kei uhi.
english: The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from Yahweh’s mouth.

paite: Huchi in Joshua in amau toh kilemna abawl a, amaute hawi ding in amau toh thu akhungta hi. Omkhawm miliante leng akiang uah akichiam uhi.
english: Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live. The princes of the congregation swore to them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ua thu akhun ua kipan ni thum nung in, akhopite uh amau kiangnai a teng sam ahi uh, chih atheikheta uh.
english: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors, and that they lived among them.

paite: Israel suante akipankhia ua, ani thum ni in akhopite uh ava tung uhi. Akhopite uh Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth leh Kiriath-jearim ahi.
english: The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.

paite: Omkhawm heutute'n TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian min lou a akiang ua ana kichiam tak ziak un, Israel suante'n akhoih kei uh. Huchi in mipi omkhawm tengteng heutute tung ah aphun uhi.
english: The children of Israel didn’t strike them, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. All the congregation murmured against the princes.

paite: Himahleh heutu tengteng in mipi omkhawm tengtengte kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian min lou in akiang uah i na kichiamta ngal ua. Huaiziak in amaute i khoih uh siang lou ahi.
english: But all the princes said to all the congregation, “We have sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. Now therefore we may not touch them.

paite: Hichibang in atung uah hih ni. I hinghawi mai ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw i tung uah thangpaihna ahong tung kha ding, akiang uah lah i na kichiam khinta ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: We will do this to them, and let them live; lest wrath be on us, because of the oath which we swore to them.”

paite: Heutute mah in akiang uah, "Hinghawi in om uhen. Himahleh omkhawm tengteng a dia sing po mite leh tui tawi mite hi uhen," achi uhi; heutute'n ana chiam khit tak sa bang un.
english: The princes said to them, “Let them live.” So they became wood cutters and drawers of water for all the congregation, as the princes had spoken to them.

paite: Joshua in amaute asamsak a, akiang uah, "Bangdia, gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi uh, chi a hon khem na hi ua? Ka kiangnai a teng sam lah na hi ngal ua.
english: Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, “Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you live among us?

paite: Huaiziak in tu in hamsiat na hi uh, na lak ua mi kuamah ka Pathian inn a dia sing pomi leh tui tawimi na hihna ua pan asuakta ngei kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you will never fail to be slaves, both wood cutters and drawers of water for the house of my God.”

paite: Amau Joshua adawng ua, "TOUPA na Pathian un asikha Mosi gam pumpi nou hon pe dia, agam luahmi tengteng na ma ua kipan ahihmang zel ding ahi, chih thu ana piak, na sikhate hon na hilhchian mahmah ua; huaiziak a noute ziak a ka hinna uh mansuah lau mahmah a, hichibang a na gamta ka hi uh.
english: They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how Yahweh your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

paite: Tu in ngai in, na khut a om ka hi ua; na ngaihtuahna a hoih leh dik a na theih bang in ka tung uah hih mai in," achi uhi.
english: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante a pan Joshua in hunkhia in, athatta kei uhi.
english: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn’t kill them.

paite: Huai ni in Joshua in aseh bang in omkhawmte leh TOUPA maitam a dia sing po mite leh tui tawi mite in asep a, tuni tan in hiaite in apang uhi.
english: That day Joshua made them wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation and for Yahweh’s altar to this day, in the place which he should choose.
